mapper.sql: id, role_name, role_code, description, status, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.status, COUNT(u.id) AS user_count FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.role_id = r.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.status ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_name, role_code, description, status, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, deleted) VALUES (#{roleName}, #{roleCode}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedTime}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_name = #{roleName}, role_code = #{roleCode}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_role SET deleted = -1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
